description: Assert the element identified by ref or selector is visible, polling until it is or timeoutMs elapses. Visible means attached, laid out, and not visibility:hidden. Returns: { ok, session_id, matched }. Errors: EXPECTATION_FAILED (not visible within timeoutMs; retryable), REF_NOT_FOUND (stale ref; carries similar_refs), TRANSPORT_UNSUPPORTED, NOT_RUNNING, BAD_ARGUMENT (invalid selector, or ref+selector both/neither).

ref.description: Element ref from a snapshot (resolves to [data-sw-ref="N"]). Provide ref OR selector.

selector.description: CSS selector. Provide ref OR selector, not both.

sessionId.description: Target session id. Omit when a single session is running.

timeoutMs.description: Max poll time in ms before EXPECTATION_FAILED (default 5000, clamped to 60000). 0 = check once.

name: electron_expect_visible
title: Expect an element visible
